output.reason: The cited bullet [ev-9f14ff2ca2e2] is one item in a list. The section intro [ev-1f419676f177] says what happens to every metric in that list: metrics that started with the `cortex_` prefix will now start with `loki_`. Operators can keep the old prefix by changing `metrics_namespace` from its default `loki` to `cortex`, and that setting is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release. So the subject is the metric `cortex_ruler_config_last_reload_successful_seconds`, and the change is a rename to `loki_ruler_config_last_reload_successful_seconds`. The exposed environments are those that keep the default `metrics_namespace`. If the operator does nothing, the metric is only available under the new `loki_` name.
